Nenou te-a vah souyu buu, Thaikhai ne sayu ngaolai.
Shu vahsouo, Mapao nou ne kue, Talo hee-a chaokhaiso,
Muteiyu teile souhaso, Mapao nou neye kowe;
Neye donou puh thaipeire, Ne rako pa hrilaitea,
Ne kuvah puhnou kho-a bue, Ne moe tea paolou süwu?

chorus: Keio! Chachi mainou varusho lou souwe
tune: Lo! The Golden Fields Are Smilling

title: SAVEPEIO
firstLine: Keio! zhaokhopu pai E nou choue
author: Alexcenah Thomas

lines: Keio! zhaokhopu pai E nou choue,

title: ABAH SAKHAI E TALAIWU?
englishTitle: Must I go An Empty Handed?
firstLine: Abah hi halia pomo nou, Sa-a Mapao daolaiwu?
author: C.C. Luther

lines: Teithe lia Puh vah soumo nou

chorus: Puh hi rako lia save moa,
tune: Must I go An Empty Handed?

title: NE TAKHAIO, DEIPHAO VEISHI
englishTitle: Go Ye Into All The World
firstLine: Doushoyu buh teizhi hi hrüyu maibue
author: G.M.J.

lines: Doushoyu buh teizhi hi hrüyu maibue,
Jisu ye zhulo ne veayu choso.
Zhuwo deiphao kikhu houkhai tea kubue,
Ko avei paoa mahrai sü phei papeio.
Daisou thailai, Jihovah nou ku-a bue,
Ne daidonou thailai? Puh zhi kulo;

chorus: Ne taho deiphao veishi hi chipaovei
tune: Go Ye Into All The World

title: LÜLOUMAI VEJÜYU LOU
firstLine: Shulo, shulo Mapao nou E khemaiye kue
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Shulo, shulo Mapao nou E khemaiye kue,
Takou, takou jubilee lousü sou po-a,
Etao Mapao khrista chipao sü poa takou.
Lülou moyu mainou vasü phou-a krayu,
Tharao, tharao cheche chipao seira tapeio,
Houzü veabumai ki veishi hi ve paodou.

chorus: Shona teivuh nou Apei hisü vapei-a bue;
Asalo, teisa bure mai pai keilo,
Cheche reihmai lisou-a; eh Jisu likhi zhulai,
Hallelujah tea sha poa eh takoulai.

title: JISU ETAO KUWE
firstLine: Jisu nou etaoye kuwe, Hashi jü talalo tea
author: Mrs. C.F. Alexander

lines: Teithe tsü Puh paivei nou paoe,
Mapao eh pa Ne pai keio;

title: RAIKÜ-A KÜ
firstLine: Zhaotu raikü akü taosü ve hi bue
author: Elizabeth C. Clephane

lines: Zhaotu raikü akü taosü ve hi bue,
Ana zhaotu khopu nou haibü-a paoe,
Rakiva nou pai ali haibüa shakoue,

title: E ASAWE VEO KUVAH HI
englishTitle: I am Happy In The Service Of The King
firstLine: Veo vei kuvah souyu hi E sashowe
author: A.H. Ackley

lines: Veo vei kuvah souyu hi E sashowe,
Hali nou peilou hoyu kaona sübue,
Veo vei kuva souyu hi E sashowe,
Teinai teirü hi-a E lousou lousüe,
Veo vei kuvah souyu hi E sashowe,
Puh bahnou süthai hilo E aetou lai,
Veo vei kuvah souyu hi E sashowe,
Ahi buyu na E puh hi povelai,

tune: I am Happy In The Service Of The King

title: LAITHOUO
firstLine: Ne khei zaipe nou hako nou buwu?
author: J.B. Mackay

lines: Ne khei zaipe nou hako nou buwu?
Zaithou hi losü ne khah be laithou,
Dzühouyu buh hi sü vahsou buso,
Khrista lülo, Puh nou khouko peilai ,
Puh hi tave ne jüpa kholourao,
Puh leshi pai keilo, neye peilai,
Ne mah buhsü thao-a tapa lourao,

title: JESU NOU VAPEIE
firstLine: Jisu nou vapeie, leireiyu va nou
author: Emily H. Miller

lines: Jisu nou vapeie, leireiyu va nou,
Teizhi hi vayu meibvü ali bü-a;
Ne nebuh hi valo, E-a valai.
Puh donou Eye valo tea paowe,
E nou vayu buh hisü Puhnou ngaowe;
Puh nou raki hinou E phebue,
Ne nebuh hi valo, E-a valai.
Deiphao hi teizhi tyali sühao buwe,
Mahmo veayu buh hi E valai,
Ne nebuh hi valo, E-a valai.
E zhai veilounou, Puh ko maihi paolai;
Ne nebuh hi valo, E-a valai.

title: ETAO KHRISTA MAIME
firstLine: Asayu lou nou sou sholo
author: Lyman G. Cuvler

lines: E khemai le teitei nou peio,

chorus: Asasho lalaikhe, le likhei soulou nou;
Hayu maisü phoulai, veayu sü heazho-a;

title: ROMÜ KHO TOULO
firstLine: A sakhemai raki vanou
author: P.P.B.
chorus: Romü khotoulo, E vewe tea Jisu nou paoe;
Ne leshi vasünou veilou süe tea paopeikhaio.

title: TASHU VAHSOULO
firstLine: Khrista  maitao tashulo
author: Frances Hill

title: VAH SOULO
firstLine: Chachire douhi , vah soure sü bue
author: Dr.

lines: Chachire douhi , vah soure sü bue,
Routhou sü meire, chachire mai hae;
Mapao nou vah soure maisü kubue,
Zhou puh nou kuyu pai keilo.
Dourou sü chathai hi pove jülo,
Veasho-a vah soumai nou buu ngaolai;

chorus: Habüa Mapao nou paoe, khouko sü peilai;
Koukhe lou mosa sü vah sou.

title: TALOU VYALO
firstLine: Deichi deizhe hilo sü nou
author: Wm. H. Gardner
chorus: Be khosü keilou-a nou takou vyalo,

title: VAHSOUO, KHEIPHA SÜ VEWE
englishTitle: Work For The Night is Coming
firstLine: Vah souo, kheipha sü vewe
author: A.L. Walker

lines: Teinghei louta laire, Ava sü halou laire,
Loutayu laire, Soulo moshi vah sourao,

tune: Work For The Night is Coming

title: CHACHIREMAI KUYU
firstLine: Holo, hailo buyu doukhemai
author: J.O. Thompson

title: HAYU MAI PHOUWE
firstLine: Hayu khemai sü phoure tavelo
author: W.A.O.

lines: Ahi velo tea puh nou ku-a bue,
Zhao paopu nou zhou la-a buwe.
Hayu mai phouwe, Jisu hi velo,

chorus: Chaolaiyu maiye sü phou save pupeio;
Etao Mapao nou buyu buh hi;
Mapao Jisu nou mahmai donou thai peire.

title: THOUTAI VUYU
firstLine: Deikho buh aveihi sünou

title: RAISÜ LAIPEI KHAIO
firstLine: Zaithou hisü ahri rai laithou peio
author: Rev.E.F.Ufford

lines: Zaithou hisü ahri rai laithou peio,
Oh! Thaonou buh sühi tave lou-a,
Bah chi-a hriloure rai laipei khaio,
Asana ne daisou nou kho-a bue?
Zhou Puh vei rako leitayu laire,
Tharao puh rako hai hata zhulaire.
Zhoushi daobu maiye rai laipei khaio,

firstLine: Jisu E Neye leshie Ne Avei baie

lines: Jisu E Neye leshie Ne Avei baie,
Ne donou deiphao vayu E thaokhaire;
Zhuvea peilousü Khai-apeio sü Ne baie,
E chuo raiki jünou Ne leshi pure.
Nenou E leshi vanou Ne leshiwe,
Ne Kros vanou thaiyu nou E hrü loure;
Shu peirü pfüpei donou E Ne leshie,
E chuo raiki jünou Ne leshi pure.
E thai-a hri-a Neye sü leshilai,
Nenou E pa hribusa  Ne sho bulai,
Thaiyu phaki hi haibüa Enou paolai,
“E chuo raiki jünou Ne leshi pure.
Buh avei sühi savayu nou khaihae,
E teisa raki nou Neye thobulai;
Varuyu peirü pfülou-a E lou soulai,
E chuo raiki jünou Ne leshi pure.

title: MAPAO E VEWE
firstLine: Mapao hinou dou sho tare, Chuwo E vewe
author: W.J.K.

lines: Mapao hinou dou sho tare, Chuwo E vewe;
Mah ludu hi E tawure, Mapao E vewe.
Muteiyu potao souhare, Chuwo E vewe;
Ngheidzü kou-a Ale liloua, Mapao E vewe.
Mah hinou ta  E veashore, Chuwo E vewe;
E Ne louchea Nechi zülai, Mapao E vewe.
Arako sü veasho-a bue, Chuwo E vewe,
Akhouko sü souhri pupeio,  Mapao E vewe.

chorus: Ki vewe veloure, Tapu khailai moe;
Chuwo E Nevei soulai, Mapao E vewe.

title: NE KOUSÜ THAOTHOUO
firstLine: Mapao Ne khouko hinou ve
author: Caesar Malan D.D.
chorus: Mapao hi ne kousü thaothouo, (3 times)
Puh likhei ne soukha peilou süe.

title: VEISHOYU TSÜ ALI
firstLine: Veishoyu tsü ali, Ahi vekhai khaire
author: Phoebe Cary

lines: Veishoyu tsü ali, Ahi vekhai khaire;
A Puo ki ngheipure, sühi buh alao bue;
Ahri nuh ngheivere, Akou thaokhaire buh;
Ahi ve ngheipupeio, E kao duta shulai;

title: JISU E VEWE
firstLine: Khayu, veayu,  maiyu buh hinou
author: W.T. Sleeper

lines: A Mapao vei vayu buh hilo, E veloure Jisu,
Amah buh hinou tapa lou-a E veloure Jisu.
Hraolaiyu, halaiyu buh hinou, E veloure Jisu Nehi,
Khupa shoyu Ne Kros phi hisü, E veloure Jisu;
Deiphao hi veayu buh hi sünou
Asayu lousü soupo-a nou E veloure Jisu.
Ne shiha sü ngaoloure donou, E veloure Jisu;
V ayu buh hi veloure donou;
Raohou zhaibüa Nehi zhao velai, E veloure Jisu.
Nevei vayu asayu hilo, E veloure Jisu;
Nevei khupa va ngaore donou, E veloure Jisu.

title: OH! CHU KHEI HINOU
firstLine: A Mapaoye sü thaokhaiso

lines: Khrista vei  zhih likhe nou baie,

chorus: Oh! Chu khei hinou ne leda louzü,
Khailu peilai, Oh! chu khei hinou.

title: VÜRA JÜNOU KAAPUE
firstLine: Mapao Jisu E licheyu hrü hrünüe
author: J. Nicholson

lines: Mapao Jisu E licheyu hrü hrünüe,
Teisa Ne Ahi nou bua hrüyu jüpae,
Ngaobamai bah hinou Eye popa peio;
Chuo Eye vüra jünou khükaa pupeio.
Mapao Jisu Ahi hashi pa buso,
Ne zhenou mahmo teitei popa laipeio;
Chuo Eye vüra jünou khükaa pupeio.
Mapao Jisu E Nevu kho-a bure,
Chuo Eye hai  mai sütholi souda peio;
Chuo Eye vüra jünou khükaa pupeio.

chorus: Chuo Eye vüra jünou khükaa pupeio.

title: KIHI VEWE
firstLine: Amahmo nou paosha hoa buma
author: Rev.A.H. Ackley

lines: Ne nou E khüshee peilou süe tea,
Puo nou moyu nahtou phouyu büa,
Ne likhei hinou E louche baie,

chorus: Kihi ve (E ki vewe) kihi ve (E ki vewe)
Mah mo ludu hisü tapu laimoe;
E kihi ve (E ki vewe) kihi ve, (E ki vewe)

title: EYE NEDO SOULO
firstLine: Mapao E ngaolouhoe, Daiki save laisa!
author: Charlotte G. Homer

lines: Mapao E ngaolouhoe, Daiki save laisa!
Raishu vedao laiho, Rose poupah daolaisa;
Avei thailo sümoe, Nenou ngaopei mohie,
Nedo nasü E süloure donou khomoe.
E dai rei kalaisa, Leveayu sounou rei,
Kare donou pimoe, E Ale vealai moe;
Süthai-apeio sü Ne, Teisa Angheiki bue,
Anahna, pikhaiso tea paoyu E nou choue,
E sasho-a nou tae, Enou tayu ludu;
Kalo velai teanou, E Nehi nouyu hae;
Nedo, Nero soulo, Süna likhei khobaie,

title: KHAILU PEIRE
firstLine: Athai hisünou khailupeie
author: Rev.S.F. Smith

title: HRÜ ASHEE NGAOLOULAI
firstLine: Teideiphao hi buyu na veishi raibü khaitoue
author: K.S.

lines: Teideiphao hi buyu na veishi raibü khaitoue,
Teitheli habailai, shoshonou dupa tsüpayu hai,
Taire Ramai nou soupei khaitouyu zhai nasüe,
Teinghei nou loutare zhai bü-a, eh mai hrü tou,
Teitheli habailai, adu atai alia soukumoe,
Mapao Jisu nou chiku veyu teile hisü,
Ne Puh hisü daisou tea paongaolai?
Hrü ashee ngaolou buyu mai nou, hatali hia,
Leveayu daolaimoe, asasho nou rako vah soulai;
Sükhemai nou raki hi Veo buhsü ngaoloulai,
Sübuh hisü ne ve bunü mowu?

title: SÜHI NOU ZHIH KUVE YUKI
firstLine: Mapao nou be hou veyu thai, teilehai bupu laimoe
author: B.M.J

lines: Mapao nou be hou veyu thai, teilehai bupu laimoe,
Shona teile büa teisa varu bulai,
Reipe holova hinou khailu loumai vedzüyuki,
V avei shoyu shona sühi lüloumai hrishu yuki,
Puh nou hrishuyu hai koa zha ngaozholai;
Puh nou dolou mai hrülai putao kihi vejü yuki,
Teinghei loumosa Mapaowo donou E pa vah soulo,
Puh vei khupa leshi ko E pa paolo;
E mai hrühai chelouzü,deiphao Avah souche louthai,

title: JIHOVAH TAKOURE
firstLine: V elaiyu Mapao vei adusho Angheithou nou ngaore
author: Julia Ward Howe

lines: V elaiyu Mapao vei adusho Angheithou nou ngaore,
Rarouyu darkha shithou pojü buh hi Puh phi taibue;
Puh nou chikulaiyu khoche hai deiphao hi phakoure,
Rakimai thethe hro hinou vaveishoa E Puhye ngaoe,
Puletao nou Puh donou sheelabuh li soushu khaitoue;
Puh vei checheyu chipao sü meiva poa E cholou süe,
Puhnou houda khailai moyu bekho sü houpa wure,
Puhnou mai hrülaiye sü chikubuh hi save khaire;
Arako thasho chila peikhaio, Aphi sashoa takhaio,
Zai thailo teidei poupah hro hinou Khristaye naloue,
Puhvei leshi khouko nou ne Eye zhu  souda peire;
Khaipeire donou Puh thaie, e tao Puh donou thailaikhe;

title: VEO TEIDEI VERE
firstLine: Vedei aveili velaitea paokhaitea kho-a buyu
author: El. Nathan

lines: Vedei aveili velaitea paokhaitea kho-a buyu,
Teisa halouho veodei süsü thasho-a velaire,
Veishoa souda khaitouyu veo teidei nasü zhi-a bue,
Teideiphao mahmo hukha hinou Etaoye popaloue,
Veo teidei vere teile sü nghei vere.
V eo teidei veyu phaki khoukobu Mapao Eh ngaolai,
A Mapaoye sü rai-a nou ngaolai;
Hallelujah sholai Puh zhenou Etao khailu peire,
Oh! Veo teidei vere teilesü ngheire.
Deiphao mai poulaonou kholouho zhinüyu büa bure,
Asayu lounou sou-a vedei kovei paopei laikhe,

chorus: Ovai, raki veodeisü ngheisho vere, (2 times)

title: SÜHI TEIZHI LAIMOE
firstLine: Jisu khaive yu ki teizhi laimoe
author: Rev.W.O. Cushing

lines: Jisu khaive yu ki teizhi laimoe,
Jisu khaive yuki  levea laimoe (3 times)
Jisu khaive yuki krapu laimoe (3 times )
Jisu khaive yuki lousou sholai, (3 times )

title: OH! SOUDA LOURAO
firstLine: Mapao phateile sü ngheivere, (ngheivere)
author: J.G..B.

lines: Mapao nü buh hi vere donou; (soudalo)
Nele souda-a bulo, Ne meibvü tao-a bulo;

title: PHAJÜTOU THAISÜ
firstLine: E khemai sousa peiyu louli soulaikhe
author: E.E.H.

lines: E khemai sousa peiyu louli soulaikhe,
Khei teile halai teisa Avasü ngaolai,
E khemai bah nou vah soulou süsa soulai,
Jihovah zhuvea nou etao khouko soulai,
E khemai nou du ashi sü souvei talai,
Oh! maikhemai leshi zhuvea vah souloutheo,
Rakilo teisa soloure buh ali bue,

title: TEITHELI VEILOULAI
firstLine: Eh nou ve ngaoloure bu u sü nghoujü hilo khaitoue
author: Dr.

lines: Eh nou ve ngaoloure bu u sü nghoujü hilo khaitoue,
Jihovah nou reikou nou eh zhubue;
Puh leshi painou kuwe piyu mahmo hisü nou,
Jisu nou nasho kue Puh ngheivere.
Eh nou Puh thaisü fü-a Puh nou peiyu toubulai,
Puh hinou popa laimoe, Ale sü soudu pulai,
Etao ki raki hibue, Etao hi chiku laimoe,
Ekhemai Puh vah soulai Puh zhih teisa paosholai,

chorus: Süthaisü ekhemai Jisu koa hrülai. (2 times)

title: JISU VEMOSA VAH SOULAI
firstLine: O soyu fü E Ne zhibue!
author: Mrs.E. Mills

lines: O soyu fü E Ne zhibue!
Puh hi tave E bai loulai,

chorus: Puh vah soulou thaisü, kihi velai.

title: JISU VEYUKI
firstLine: Jisu nou buu peilai tea veyuki
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Jisu nou buu peilai tea veyuki,
Puh lülouchea mei bvü taoa khobuyu?
Ehnou souyu Puh hi pove yuki,
Etao chechea Puh lü louchea buwu?
Zhaihea Puh nou ngaolou mai rako veie,
Puh shona ve-a khei tsü veyuma,

chorus: Ne Enou khoyu Puh nou ngaolai-wu?

title: ZHUHAO NOU VEDAOLAI MAPAO
firstLine: Enou Jisu zhu ngaoyuki
author: Mrs.Frank A.Breck

lines: Chu Enou Puh zhu ngaotao moe,
Puh zhu E nou ve ngaolai.

chorus: E puh zhu vuzü nou ngaolai,

title: RAMAI VEDEISÜ
englishTitle: The Kingdom Of God Is Within You
firstLine: Pharisee maitao nou Ramai teidei hai
author: S.P.P.

lines: Pharisee maitao nou Ramai teidei hai,
Jisu nou puletao hisü chila peie,
Ramai vedei hai ngheithou nou ngaolou
Jisu nou Puh rozü mai tao hisü paoe,
Teile ngaonü shoyu phasü velai dao.
Puh letao nou neletao hisü paolai,
Zhukhaio, zhukhaio Puh sü haihi bue,
Hohi bue tea paoyuma  thaihai füso,

chorus: Daiwo louzü Ramai vedei sü neletao
Mapao vei teilesü mai lina ngaolaimoe.
tune: The Kingdom Of God Is Within You

title: KHRISTA TEIHAO PEINOU VELAI
englishTitle: Christ Is Coming In The Cloud
firstLine: Khrista teihaopei vanou velai Puh veki, (2 times)

lines: Khrista teihaopei vanou velai Puh veki, (2 times)
Puh khei toutsü phaki velai ho;
Po theli Saitan hukha pfülai, Puh veki (2 times)
Khristamai donou asa sholai, Puh veki (2 times)

chorus: Puh veki : (Asawo ne souda loure moe?)
Jisu veki : (Atupai ne souda loure moe?)
Puh veki : (Oh! mahmai ne Puh daolou süwu?)
Deiphao velai : ( Puh deiphao vahi velai)
Puh vere halia paosü khai moe,
tune: Christ Is Coming In The Cloud

title: MAPAO JISU NOU PAOE
firstLine: Mapao Jisunou paowe, Elaire soudalo

lines: Avei, ashi dolai; ali polai, ali laiwulai;

title: JIHOVAH NOU NE PA SALAILO
firstLine: Jihovah nou ne pa salailo
author: J.E. Rankin D.D.

lines: Puh shoukhe nou ne ve bailo;
Puh leshi bah nou ne vohpeie,

title: HAI THAO MAIYE?
firstLine: Thao mai-ge? thaomai nou raki
author: Anna Shipton

title: ZHAOTU ZHENOU KHÜSHEELOUE
englishTitle: Washed In The Blood Of The Lamb
firstLine: Thao thao maitao dzükhü pehi buyu
author: T.

lines: Thao thao maitao dzükhü pehi buyu,
Zheizhei buyu khüh pehi bumai thaoe?
Putao hai ngaopiyu reih soumai taoe;

chorus: Ashee Jerusalem romü hi sou sheeyu
tune: Washed In The Blood Of The Lamb

title: KHO-A BU-WE
firstLine: Kho-a buwe, zhiyu khu nou ve sühao louyu koute
author: Mrs. Frances L.Mace

lines: Kho-a buwe, zhiyu khu nou ve sühao louyu koute,
Kho-a buwe, heako teiva nou akhai souyu koute;
Deiphaohi khei tala tare, Alethou hi vapare,
Raki hi teivuh dekou-a va hamosa kho-a bue.
Kho-a buwe, rouvamai nou kihi pojüyu koute,
Teile teile tala tare, teile veinasü vere;
Thara sou-a pove jülo, Teile hai kaotou tea bue,
Pahpayu hrü raita khaire, E thasho tara laire.
Kho-a buwe, rakimai nou romü houpayu koute,
Kholouho soua, vuzhi-a bue, V eayu nou paohao louhoe;
Putao pai E dou shoa choue,
Puletao nou E kulouzü,  Khobue putao chizülai.
Kho-a buwe, E ngaoyu teitei jü veiyu ki donou,
Ahri vei süübe pahpa bue, Dourou sü daiva tea bue,
E khailoure donou khobue, Amah khaipeiyu phaki;
Mahmo teitei raita khaire, Veayu sounou bulaimoe.

title: DAIKI VERE SARO!
firstLine: Chaolai-a buh Anahtou sü
author: R.L.

lines: Puh nou pfü khoubou hi taobuki,

title: DAIZHOU VEISHOSA
firstLine: Mapao ve sholoure phahai
author: F.J.Crosby

lines: Jihovah Nahpoutu zhih nou, Pove jüpei yuki;
Ratayu thashoa veyuma, Puh chipao hinou paoe,
Teitheli etao mai hrülai, Raki nou khedaolai.
Ovai, etao veayu phinou, Ta-a vabuh velai,
Etaoye leshi-a khoyu, Nuh hisü veloulai;
Teithe chitea, potei daoti, Teikhai teirü daoma,
Teisa savayu lou sou-a, Raki nou khedaolai.

title: NGHEIDZÜ PAYU THAI
firstLine: Akilo velaiyu ludu sü
author: F.J. Crosby
chorus: Vahsou cheyu thaisü E ve solai;
Sheeyu maime nou  sayu lousou pai keilo,
Ki veishoyu buh hinou vejülai (ki vejü lai) .

title: MAPAO NEHI VEWE
firstLine: Mapao Nehi vewe, Nehi vewe
author: Sarah F. Adams

lines: Ne leshi zhuvea hai, Ahi seipeio;
Sayu shou pfülou-a E zhao talai,
Khou, teinghei, vuh sü thaoa, E zhaokhelai,

title: ZAIDU TACHOLOU THAI
firstLine: Jisu zhenou soukaa louthai
author: A.E. Childs

lines: Hatali veyuma pimoe, Lü vanou E raki sü ngaoe;
Leshi samaiye daoyu thai, Rako hrülai nou soloulai;
Sü teithe daizhou asalai, Sana romü sü houpalai;
Mapao Aphi süthai tapeio, Sünou E asayu ngaolai ;

chorus: Zaidu tacholou thai,  Zaidu tacholou thai

englishTitle: Blest Be The Tie That Binds
firstLine: Leshiyu rai sünou
author: Rev.J. Fawcett
tune: Blest Be The Tie That Binds

title: EH REIPE HI VEJÜ LAIWU?
englishTitle: Shall We Gather At The River
firstLine: Eh reipe hi vejü lai-wu? Raki mainou tayu buh
author: R.L.

lines: Eh reipe hi vejü lai-wu? Raki mainou tayu buh;
Teisa leiriyu dzüla sü, Jihovah Veobuh nou küe.
Reipe sühi vete lou-a, Dzü khüshee louyu thaisü;
Etao teisa Mapao tholai, Teithetsü asa bulai.
Etao reipe vemo jünou, Kousüyu teitei thaorao;
Etao rako vupa peilai, Zaodu ea peirü peilai.
Sana reipe hi tha velai, Avei du hai tachelai;
Ale sayu thasho ngaolai, Kaonayu lousü soulai.

chorus: Ovai, reipe hinou daolai, Veisho buyu,
tune: Shall We Gather At The River

title: HOLO DEICHIVA
firstLine: Holo deichiva füli bue
author: Rev.E. Adams

title: VEISHOYU TEITHELI
firstLine: Heako jünou veiyu nuh li bue
author: S.F. Bennett

lines: Heako jünou veiyu nuh li bue,
Lü vanou nuh sü eh ngao-a bue;
Reipe nou etao ve lou soulai,
Etao hrüsü Puh nou soushee peie.

title: RAMAINOU KHOPEILAI
firstLine: Leveasou, hatali vema, Jisu nou kho peilai

lines: Leveasou, hatali vema, Jisu nou kho peilai;
Puhvei shoukhe nou ve bailo, Jisu nou khopeilai.
Teithetsü vahsoua leveaki, Jisu nou khopeilai;
Ne ludu hi ngaopi yuki, Jisu nou khopeilai.
Ne nou koyu Puh nou peilai, Jisu nou khopeilai;
Ne nou khoyu sü lailaimoe, Jisu nou  khopeilai.
Pimoe hatarali vema, Jisu nou khopeilai;
Levea mai Puh hinou vülo, Jisu nou khopeilai.

title: JIHOVAH NOU NEYE SALAI PEILAI
englishTitle: God Will Take Care Of You
firstLine: Jihovah nou neye salai peilai
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Puh nou neye soutao sou khopeilai,
Puh nou neye panou lata laimoe.
Ne phika kapa tsü salai peilai;
Puh vei leshi hasü nehi peilai;
Puh nou neye sa-a raki khelai.

chorus: Ne Puoe, ne sae, ne khailupei Mapaoe;
Puh nou neye khopeilai, Puh lülo.
tune: God Will Take Care Of You

title: E KIHI VETALAI
englishTitle: I am Going Home At Last
firstLine: Ahrü  hrüche-a teinghei louyu büa khai souyu kisü
author: Rev. Johnson Oatman, Jun

lines: Ahrü  hrüche-a teinghei louyu büa khai souyu kisü ,
A ludu hi buna veishi thaoa talai;
Süpha kisü E ha ngaolou-a Puhye sü khe daolai,
E nou tayu ludu sü tashi sho-a  taveyuma,
E thashoa Akihi vetalai, Jihovah nuh hisü,
Athai khu buyu deikho hi Enou tacho payuki,
Khaipei Mapao vei bah Enou pailoulai;
Puh nou koa talai tea paopei donou Arako pimoe,

chorus: A kihi vetalai, A kihi vetalai,
Ludusü ta chewu thaisü, A kihi vetalai.
tune: I am Going Home At Last

title: E NETAO VE DAOLAI
englishTitle: I Hope To Meet You All
firstLine: Vashoyu buh hinou ve daolai
author: Emma Pitt
composer: Wm. J. Ki rk pat ri ck
chorus: Vavei shoyu reipe, sana buh sü,
Sühi nou ve daolai, E netao vedaolai,

firstLine: Deiphao asamai daolou yuma

firstLine: Enou choue lou souyu paili

firstLine: Mapao zhih hinou asalo

author: Margaret Moody

lines: Mah soumai nou le dalou-a veki,

Veiyu mai linou rei kachopa thai,

firstLine: E Jisu Khrista ngaolou thai
author: P. Doddridge

lines: Mapao Aveie E sü Puh veie;
E Puh hi ve Puh vei soulai.

title: POU PEIYU MAPAO
firstLine: Poupeiyu Mapao sü vere, Zhuvea süyu hai Jisue
author: Wm. Hunter

lines: Poupeiyu Mapao sü vere, Zhuvea süyu hai Jisue;
Mai hrülaiye souna peilai, Oh! Jisu pai sü keilo.
Ne mahmo sü khailu peire, Oh! Jisu paisü keilo;
Kaona shoa rakilo taveo, Jisu sa peirü pfülo.
Sholo hrishuyu zhaotu sü, E chuo Jisu lülouche;
Khailupeiwo zhihsü leshie, Jisu zhihsü E leshie.
Puh zhih nou piyu hulai peie,
Varuyu raki veyuki, Etao Jisuye ngaolai;

title: PUH HRIE, PUH HRIE
firstLine: E khai-a peio kuvah soue
author: A.H.A.

lines: E nou süe Puh hai hria bue,
E ngaoe Puh vei zhuvea bah,
Enou koyu teile hi Puh ngheiteia bue.
Anghoujü bu deiphao hi, E nou Puh leshi ngaoe,
Alüthou hi vea bu-a, E lekhaita laimoe,
E süe Puh nou süthaipeie, teikhai teirü ho hia,
Puh dakhai vere teithe, Khai soua velai.
Salo salo, O Khristamai, nepai kua lou souo,
Khaihayu Hallelujah , Jisu Khrista Veo hi,
Puh hai lüloumai hrülaiye soukha peiyupue;
Puh vei leshi jünou dukouyu lia hae.

chorus: Puh hrie, (Puh hrie) Puh hrie (puh hrie) ,
Khrista Jisu hri bue,  Puh E koa tae
Puh hrie, (Puh hrie) Puh hrie (Puh hrie)
Khailu peiyu peilai, Puh hrie touyu ne
Ahi nouo? Puh hrie alüthou hi.

title: LOU ASHEENA
firstLine: Asayu lousü E nou sounü shoe
author: Flora L. Best

lines: Asayu lousü E nou sounü shoe,
E nou souyu louhai veiyu nou phoubue,
Teimai teizhi sü shona büa vapeie.
E lahamai libüa levea bu laiwu?
Puh nou ki veishoyu buh nasü ngaopeie,
Kaonasha nou paoe,”Nevei buh li bue”.
E nou süe buh sühi teizhiyu lia hae,
Ava ludu nou Puh hi savelai.

chorus: O, loua... sheena, ... loua shee  nasü
E nou chu soulai, Khailoumai  hisü,

title: REIHSÜ VERE
firstLine: Reih sü vere, shabe khosü houpu  pare
author: Mrs.

lines: Reih sü vere, shabe khosü houpu  pare,
Mapao nou hupoa takoue veiloure donou,
Khrista nou thashoa reih sü veiloulai.
Reihsü vere, shulo khuveiyu reihmai tao!
Takhaio, Ramai nou peiyu reihna tudaloua,
Mapao nou veiloure hilo süthai talai;
Puh dusho zhih teidei buh liki khuhaolai,

chorus: Reih soure maitao, Na tyali thouloua,

title: HALLELUJAH KROS DONOU
firstLine: Latou tea buyu kros, Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
author: Arr. Dr.H. Bonar4/4

lines: Latou tea buyu kros, Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Meizai teikhai hüpoa deiphao vahi vere
’Na kros jü veilou moe, Hallelujah kros donou.
Dao-rai nou buyu kros, Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Kros vei ko paolaikhe, Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Ramai zhuvea leshi Khrista hinou vapeie,
Mah hinou vupa peie, Hallelujah Kros donou.
Kros hinou mah khailoue, Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Jisu eh mah pfüpeie, Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Südonou kros hive, Khrista Mapaoye sü,
Etaonou lou soushoe, Hallelujah kros donou.

chorus: Kros hai pa hakhai laimoe. (2 times)

title: KROS VEI SAHRA
firstLine: Veonou reih veilouyu vanou peikhaitou
author: E.L. Nathan

lines: Khailoumai taonou lou sou-a bu phaki,
Ngaobamai nou zaidzü büa vejü yuma ,
Mapao vei reihmai libüa Puh phi hinou,
Zhe büa hoyu sahra kosü pao peikhao,
Vei kayu shona teithe payu phaki,
Etao Veo nghoujü nou ngaobamai halai,

title: KHRISTA REIHMAI TAO
firstLine: Hukou khaio, eitea teyu reihmai tao!
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Hukou khaio, eitea teyu reihmai tao!
Hukou khaio, sahra pola lou-a; Soutao souo,
Puh zhuvea nou ne veilou vuzülai,
Reihbuh hi ne nou ngavu zülai.
Khrista vei, kros sü pfüla shulou-a,

chorus: Hukou khaio, Saitan nou khuyu buh hi,
Nghoujü kou, reihmai nou ne duyuma,

title: NAHTU KHEMAI NOU
firstLine: Nahtukhe mainou khailupei ko poyu  taoe
author: Julia Sterling

lines: Nahtukhe mainou khailupei ko poyu  taoe,
Putaonou e h K hai-apeio nou k ros pfüyu ko paolai,
Soteithe kini nou putao nou Baibel seie,
Süna nou reipe lilova bumai le sousa peilai.
Puletao nou vea-hoyu phaki sasho-a talousüe;
Rako nou veasho-a buyu phateile hi,
Putao nou teinghei va büa zhuveayu chipao nou chalai.
Puletao nou Khai-apeio vei hasü thasho ngaolai;
Puhnou putao zhubue, Puh chipao veilai moe,
Süwolouzü Raki hi nou teisa Puo vei zhu ngaolai.

chorus: Nahtukhe mainou chipao vei poyu taoe,
Nahtukhe mainou chipao vei poyu taoe,

title: KHRISTA CHI ZÜLO
firstLine: Adou kounou sahra sü  po zha-a laire
author: E.T. Cassel

lines: Adou kounou sahra sü  po zha-a laire,
Khrista chi zülo, chi zülo tea sha laire;
Deichi peiva hinou, lousou po-a laire,
Khrista chi zülo tea nou lousü soupoa laire.
Ne Puh paisü keilo, Deiphao hi shavewe,
Khrista chi zülo, chi zülo tea shalaire;
Khrista chi zülo tea nou, reihkhaomai shapaokhaio.
Tave meli soulo, Etao nou veiloulai,
Khrista chi zülo, chi zülo tea shalaire;
Saitan vei sahra sü, Etao nou koloulai,
Khrista chi zülo tea nou, Etao ko seitalai.
Eh nahlemai khouko, Jisu donou peilai,
Khrista chi zülo, chi zülo tea shalaire;
Deiphao kaihou daihi chipao shave telai,
Khrista chi zülo tea nou, deiphao hi shatalai.

chorus: Puh nou paolo velai, Teidei sü ngaoloulai,
Khrista chi zülou vanou, Ovai zülou vanou.

title: SHARON POUP A LOU AHI SOUNGAOPEIO
englishTitle: Sing Me A Song Of Sharon’s Rose
firstLine: Sharon Rose lou Ahi sou ngaokhaio

lines: Sharon Rose lou Ahi sou ngaokhaio,
Teisa nou E ludu moa tawe,
Chuo E Rose poupah ve daoloue.
Sharon Rose pah Eye dungao peio.

chorus: E donou pabue, Sharon Rose pah,
Ale sashoe Rose pah ngaolou vanou.
tune: Sing Me A Song Of Sharon’s Rose

title: VABUH HI TAYU
firstLine: Mapao phihea thao-a talai tea tewe
author: L.H. Edmunds

lines: Mapao phihea thao-a talai tea tewe,
Vewo thaisü fülai tea te-a bue;
Puh vanou eletao hrü souda lou-a,
Lü vanou Mapao phihea thao-a ta-we,
Etao nou Puhye zhai veishoa ngaoyuki,

chorus: V abuh hi tayu, V a buhi tayu,

title: KHRISTA REIHMAI ME
firstLine: Khrista mai me holo hailo
author: L.F.Lindsay
chorus: Etao ha ngaoloure donou veachi paolai.

title: TAKOU, REIMAI
firstLine: Takou, reihmai, takou zhounou
author: F.J. Crosby

title: TE-A BUYU REIHMAI
firstLine: Te-a buyu reih mai bekho sü keilo
author: I.D.S.

lines: Te-a buyu reih mai bekho sü keilo,
Khrista hai E khopeiyu Mapao cheche,
Puh vedei hi maihrülai donou vah  bue,
Thailaiyu souhe peio, kaoyu phao lapeio;
Etaoye  kuyu Puh hi chechea bulo,
Sahkaasü balou nou teiva hi talo;
Puhchi sü zütaoloua etao buu ngaolai,

chorus: Reihzü shishoyu hia Puh ngheitei-a bue,

title: TEIVA HINOU TAYU
firstLine: Teiva hinou tayu hai daizhozhou veie
author: W.R. Lindsay

lines: Teiva hinou tayu hai daizhozhou veie,
Vidzü kouyu shona moa khei teile hia;
Mapaowo pai keilo, Puh chihai zülo,
Khai koute Puh leshi soutao sou lülo,

title: TE-A HUKOUYU LOU
firstLine: Khrista reih maitao, keinoulo paisü
author: F.J. Crosby

lines: Mapao zhih hinou reih kolou süe;
Mapao nou souda khaitou füdei hi,
Reih hai chelou thai, kolouyu thaisü,

chorus: Reihmai takoulo, Mapao vei pai keio,
Etao reih buh hisü sakou peio.

title: JISU REIHMAILI SOULO
firstLine: Jisunou ne panou Puh reihmaili sounüe
author: W.S. Brown

lines: Jisunou ne panou Puh reihmaili sounüe,
Puhnou ne kubuki, Ne Puhchi zülo;
Nele teitei sünou, Puh chi zütaolo,
Kheloumai sü panou Puh reihmaitao soulo,
Teithetsü E panou, Puh vah sounüwe;
Puh E thaowu laimoe, E salai peilai;
Ne-a Jisu reih maili sü souhalo.
Zhuvea leshi vanou Puh nou neye kuwe,
Jisu hi vehalo, Chu neye kuwe;

chorus: Puhchi zülo; E-a Puh reih mailie,
Nea soulo; Jisu E khowo süe
Ne-a Jisu reih maili sü souhalo.

title: SHONAJÜ VEISHOHIE
firstLine: Newo shonajü veisho hie
author: F.J.Crosby

lines: Lüh the kirou nou the kirou,

title: KROS VEI REIHMAI LI
firstLine: E kros vei reihmai aliwu?
author: Isaac Watts

lines: Mai kukhe nou reih sou-a nou,

title: KHRISTA REIHMAI TAKOULO
firstLine: Khrista reihmai khemai reih hi takoulo
author: S. Baring Gould (byper)

lines: Khrista reihmai khemai reih hi takoulo,
Mapao Jisu ye zhuo, Puh nou rai peiwe;
Khrista nou Paopuo süe, ngaoba mai dulai,
Reih hisü takoulo, Puh sahra zhulo.
Mapao Jisu zhih nou Saitan tutalai,
Khrista reihmai khemai nou reih koloulai;
Khouko bu reihmai büa nghoujülo takoue,
Sheeyu mainou tayu hi Etao tawe;
Etao tara laimoe, Etao ali baie,

chorus: Khrista reihmai khemai, reih hi takoulo,
Jisuye sü zhulo, Puh nou rai peiwe.

title: VEO REIHMAI TAOE
firstLine: Etao Veo reih maitaoe, Puh zhenou khailupeie
author: D.W. Wittle

lines: Etao Veo reih maitaoe, Puh zhenou khailupeie;
Reih züre donou doloure, Khrista donou zülai,
Kaoshi sü vedaolai, Ana Eh lousou we;
Etao Veo reihmai taoe,Puh zhih sashoa poloue,
Etao Veo Khrista süe, E chuwo asashoe,
Veayu tali vetheo, Mapao Jisu zhih khuhaolai,
Etao Veo reihmai taoe, Puh koa Etao velai;
Puh koa ahrao louzü, Puh sahra pokulo;

title: REIHMAI VEI LOU
firstLine: Tashulo khailulou khemai
author: Arr. From Falkner , 1723, by E.N.
chorus: Sha paokhaio ara sou-a nou,} (2 times)

title: REIH VOS ü SOULO
firstLine: ( v i g o r o u s l y )
author: W.F.S.

lines: ( v i g o r o u s l y )
Ne tsüle veishi Puh hi  thaothouo.
Reih vei rü nasü nou-a takoulo,
Oh Ramai nenou etao pai keipeio,

title: TEIVA NAHMAI
firstLine: Avah hi buyu nahmai bü-a
author: E.E. Hewitt

title: E JISU JÜP A HIE
firstLine: E Jisu jüpa hie, Pousha sana jü

lines: E Jisu jüpa hie, Pousha sana jü,
Hushu zheebuyu Puh, bah pa süthaio.
E Jisu züpa hie, mainou shoyu jü,
E Puh louche-a veasho hrüyu ngahie;
E Jisu jüpa hie, Zhih tayu jünou,
E cheche hrülai, Puh zhih hisünou.
Poupah veishi jünou, Puh zhai veisho hie,
Puhwo vaohi laivou dzü jünou dzühie;
Arako nou jüpa tousho Puh hi bue,
E Puh jüpa hie, Puh pa süthailai.

title: JISU SHARON HI POUPA
firstLine: Jisu Sharon poupah Alehi pabue

lines: Khrista vei leshi alia tsüdo vei hai,
Buh hrülai hi Avanou pa süloulai.
Ngaoposhu zhai veiyunou paosha lou hoe;
Teisanou nevei zhuvea nou Eye hai,
Jisu Sharon poupah, Zhai veisho pabue,
Nenou zhopei-a pa le hriyu soulo.

chorus: Puh leshi vanou Alethou pei vabue.

title: NAHLEMAI LOU
firstLine: Takouo, nahle khemai nghoujülo

lines: Tahrü khemai kailou hoa zhia bure,

title: ZHOU HAI AVEIE
firstLine: Zhouhai  Aveie, dosho vemoa sümoe

lines: Maihrü hai zhou teithe che-a sümoe;
Souvei tea Mapao nou paolai mosa,

title: NE V ANOU JISUYE PA NGAOLO
englishTitle: Let Others See Jesus In You
firstLine: Neye koa buyu samai nou
author: B.B. McK
chorus: Nenou tayu buh liki hi paongao peio;
tune: Let Others See Jesus In You

title: NE DONOU BUH BUE
firstLine: Nevei ve buh Veo peirü thaoa nou
author: E.S.Elliott

lines: Nevei ve buh Veo peirü thaoa nou,
Lakhao hai raohou chaore buh bue,

title: KAONAYU NAH POUTU
firstLine: Khopeiyu Nahpoutuo ali
author: M.Bruce

lines: Puh zhih kaona Veo tea kulai,

title: KEILO! RAKI VAMAI LOU
firstLine: Keilo, raki vamai lou, “Nahtou Veo aveisü souo”
author: Charles Wesley

lines: Keilo, raki vamai lou, “Nahtou Veo aveisü souo”
Deiphao hi kaona loutheo, Ramai mah mai chaveiloue,
Tyahrü teitei asalo, Rakimai koa asalo,
Rakivamai nou shawe, ‘Khrista Bethlehem nou nae’
Kei-lo! Rakivamai lou, ‘Nahtou Veo avei sü souo.’
Khrista akhaiha Mapao, Akukulai hinou thoe;
Teile kaotou tea Puh ve, Loumaina lihi nou nae;
Ramaiye vasou nou ngaoe, Mai vitayu Ramai tho,
Maihrü büa maiye sahrüe, Jisu, etao Immanuel!
Keilo! Rakivamai lou,”Nahtou V eo avei sü souo”.
Rakibu Mapao tholo, Acheche Mapao tholo,
Puh nou ahri sü pfüve, Souvei loure Puh hi bue;
Puh vei savayu sü thaoa, Mai thaimore donou ve-e,
Deiphao mai khaipei laitea, Ahri sü peilai tea ve,
Keilo! Raki vamai lou,” Nahtou V eo avei sü souo”.

title: BETHLEHEM
firstLine: Oh!taishoyu nuh Bethlehem, Eh nou ne ngaoposhu
author: B.P. Brooks

lines: Oh!taishoyu nuh Bethlehem, Eh nou ne ngaoposhu,
Louchemoa buyu phahinou, Teivu nou ne vapeie;
Maiyu Ne ludu hi, Khaiha va nou vapeie,
Deiphao mainou zhishoyuna, Zhou khei Neye
Mary nou Khristaye napeie, Rakimai nou ve ngaoe,
Pfüphao nou zü zhibu phaki, Rakimai nou khopeie;
Oh! shona teivuh ko-a  Puh nayu shapao khaio,
Ramai Vewo lousou sholo, Deiphao kaona loutheo.
Daizhozhou kaonasha tea nou, Khupayu pha sü peie,
Jihovah nou mai lethou hi, Raki vei ha peire,
Mailia sümoe Puh veyu, Deiphao mah buh hisü,
Lenayu mainou Puh ngaoloue, Khrista tave loupeie.
Oh Bethlehem sheeyu nahtu, Zhou eh Ne kho-a bue,
Amah khaipeio, Ale loupeio, Zhou Ahi ve napeio;
Rakimai lou eh chouwe, Asayu chipaoyu,
Eh hi vepeio, eh koa bupeio, Mapao Immanuel.

title: VULI DA VID NUH HI
firstLine: Vuli David nuh hisü nou
author: Mrs.

lines: Pfü nou Nahtou li pozü  khaie,
Puh nou raki nou deiphao koue,
Puh nou chaoyu sü rhei khaibue,

title: ZHOUKHEI HI VELOURE
firstLine: Leiriyu khei toutsü hinou, Daodao louli sou-we
author: Edmund H. Sears

lines: Leiriyu khei toutsü hinou, Daodao louli sou-we,
Rakimai nou deiphao hive, Loubvü po-a lousoue;
Deiphao kaona, maiveia hrülo, Raki V eo zhuvea nou,
Deiphao teitei kaonasha tea, Raki mailou kei bue.
Putao raki hinou kouwe, Kaonayu shoupfü-a,
Chukoute rakivei lousoue, V eayu deiphao teitei;
V eayuma deikho pei hisü, Putao shoupfüa zhao bue,
Sokhaimoa pai shurao soubue, Rakimai lousouwe.
Levea kousü laimai hrülai, Dopfü bumai hrülai,
Ludusa koupfütayu mai, Veasho nou hrüyu mai;
Zhukhaio asayu teile sü, Thasho nou zhao laire,
V eayu ludu pehi bumai, Rakimai lou keilo.
Zhukhaio teile sü thasho ve, Daorai nou paoyu  büa,
Potei nou thaomoa takouwe, Teile veisü vewe;
Deiphao teitei kaonayu thai, Daodao ralea halai,
Deiphao teitei lousou pulai, Rakimai lou souyu.

title: ZHEI ZHEI KHEI
firstLine: Zheizhei khei, sheeyu khei
author: Joseph Mohr

lines: Mana phi-a zübue, Mana phi-a zübue.

title: RAKIMAI AKUHI NOU
englishTitle: Angels We Have Heard On High
firstLine: Rakimai aku hinou, Leshisho lou souyu choue
author: Traditional

lines: Rakimai aku hinou, Leshisho lou souyu choue;
Deichi peinou shoyu pai, Putao pai khana büwe,
Zhaokho mainou Jubilee, Lousou-a sasho-a bue;
Sayu chipao sünanou, Rakimai lousou-a bue.

tune: Angels We Have Heard On High

title: RHEIKHAOHI POZÜE
firstLine: Rhei khao hi pozüe, zükhu sah-a ngaomoe
author: M. Luther (1483-1546)

lines: Rhei khao hi pozüe, zükhu sah-a ngaomoe,
Rakiva vuhtou nou sühi zhu-a bue,
Nahtou Jisu sü rheikhao hinou zü bue.
Meri nou Nahtou khoabue Nahtou zhimoe,
E Neye leshi tea rakimai nou paoe,
Teithe pamosa kaona sho-a zü bue.
Mapao Jisu Ahi-a bupeio tea khoe,
Raki nou Ne sa hrüre donou chopeio.

title: ZHAOTU KHOBU PHAKI
firstLine: Zhaokho mai sünou rehzü-a
author: N.T ate

lines: Rakiva Siraphim nou shae, Raki maime sa-a;
Aku kulai Ramai sho-a, Putao nou lou souwe.
Aku kulai Ramai sholo, Deiphao kaona bulo;

title: TAVE PUHYE THO LAIKHE
englishTitle: Oh! Come All Y e Faithful
firstLine: Tavelo lüloumai asasa tavelo
author: Mercr(tr)

lines: Tha-a Bethlehem nuh hi tave laikhe;
Zhuo, Nahtouye sü rheikhao hi zükhai toue.
Shulo, shulo raki mainou lousou showe,
Deiphao mai hrülai nou Puhye pao sholo;
Mapao nou Veo hrülai jü kukulai süe.
Mapao ye pao sholai, Khailu peiyu vanou,
Mapao Jisu, teisa Ne zhih paosholai;
Chipao sünou vasou dalou-a nou ve.

tune: Oh! Come All Y e Faithful

title: DEIPHAOMAI ASALO
firstLine: Deiphaomai hrülai asalo
author: Isaac Watts

lines: Mai hrülai nou Puh ko paolai,
Mai hrülai nou Puh chi zülo.

title: CHAOBUH ALIA HAE
firstLine: Buhzüh avei li-a Ki sühi khaimoe
author: A.L. Skilton

lines: Buhzüh avei li-a Ki sühi khaimoe,
Rheikhao likhei  buwe, Puh pei khaire hae;
Sa-a paoshoyu hae, Mah donou chomoe,
Veayu likhei bubaie, Chao buh alia hae.
Maiye leshiyu hae, Chaoloure buh hae;
Mapao donou chomoe, Mah donou domoe,
Mapao jüpa  souyu mai alia-a hae.
Mahmo donou kra-a Mapao phoumai hae,
Puh vei jüpa soumoe, chaobuh alia hae.

chorus: Buh hae, buh hae, Jisu donou,

title: KHRISTAMAI ASALO
firstLine: Khristamai asalo, Tsüle rako nou koa
author: Tr. by John M. Neale

lines: Khristamai asalo, Tsüle rako nou koa,
Chu Puh hai rheikhao hinou züe,
Khrista zhou naloue, Khrista zhou naloue.
Khristamai asalo, Tsüle rako nou koa,
Sasho ko ne chu keilo sa-shoe!
Puh hai teisa nou rako veie,
Puh südonou nae, Puh südonou nae.
Khristamai asalo, Tsüle rako nou koa,
Khailupei laitea, Puh sü nave peie.

title: SAVASHO NE PA SOLOUE
firstLine: Savasho ne pa soloue, Halia ne levea so
author: Traditional
composer: Tra di t i o na l

lines: Savasho ne pa soloue, Halia ne levea so,
Lilo Khrista Mapao na loue, Khristmas teithe zhou;
Etaoye Saitan bah Hinou khai peire donou.
Raki buyu E Puo hinou rakivamai ve,
Zhaokho maihi putao nou ko avei pove peie;
Kabüa Bethlehem hinou Jisu naloue touyu.
‘Piso’ tea rakivamai nou paoe, ne ngaopiso,
Sheeyu loumaina li hinou zhou Mapao naloue;
Puh louche mai Saitan hukha hinou phalaitea.
Mapao nabuh Bethlehem hi putao veyuki,
Putao nou nahtou chokhao hinou zü-a ngaoloue;
Puh pfü Mari nou khoukhü Mapao hi veachi paoe.

chorus: Oh! sava shoyu ko avei, sava yu ko,

title: EH TEINGHEI P ALO VEO ASÜ
firstLine: Eh teinghei palo veo asü, Sapeina po-a tavewe
author: J.H.H.

lines: Eh teinghei palo veo asü, Sapeina po-a tavewe;
Teivu thai füa vewe, Deichi deikho tacho po-a.
Bethlehem hinou nayu Veo, Panou sana peirü rülai;
Khouko ava sü pongaolai, Teisa hriyu V ewo.
E kaivei thadzü povewe, Kainü veina Mapao Nehi,
V eachi paoyu, paoshoyu nou pei pfü nakou laikhe.
Hrümai veayu pongaoloure, E kaivei poudzü povewe;
V eayu, hoyu, krayu thaiyu khüh hinou povulai.

title: JISU B ü A VEMAILI NAVEMOE
firstLine: Deiphaohi vemaisü chosha louho buwe

lines: Ana Veo Khrista bü-a vemai lia pamoe;
Teinghei vuh nou pulekhe ludu süthaipeie;
Pfü Meri nou nah poa buyu ve ngaolou-a,
Herod veo nou chouloua leveasho-a bure,

chorus: Sholoure lou souyu deiphao hi phouloure,

title: MAP AO KHAI SOUPEIO
firstLine: Mapao neha nou khai soupeio
author: Rev J. Fawcett

lines: Ne leshi mail ili hi peio,
Eh teisa nou, Oh ! teisa nou,

title: TEILE ALIA KHAIHA
firstLine: Teile sü tha tamoe
author: Dr. H. Bonar

lines: Hrire donou thaibaie, thaiyu athai tara baie,
Etao teisa hriwe, Etao donou athai hae;

title: TEILE NOU THA TA-WE
firstLine: Teile nou tha shopo takoue

lines: Deiphaova ludu mail thethe, Alili tala tapa;
Ludu tare tache louzü, Rako kihi vetalai.

title: VEIYU HRÜHAI PHAJÜBAIE
englishTitle: Life At Best Is Very Brief
firstLine: Emai hrühai phazübaie, Süünghou nou raiyu bübaie
